proposedDirectGuards.directReason: Preserve the actual source edge; both actual Russian labels contain угол; distinguish かど and すみ in prose.
The actual accepted 車 caption includes транспортное средство and автомобиль; a taxi vehicle fits both in ordinary travel.
The hired car sense of タクシー fits the actual автомобиль caption; not a claim that every automobile is a taxi.
The actual broad транспортное средство label fits an ordinary passenger bus.
The ordinary motor-vehicle sense of 自動車 includes an автобус; preserve the car/bus distinction in teaching.
A distinct exact-spelling バス lexical object denotes bass fish; the actual current label рыба is defensible for that homograph. Do not merge this identity into the transport entry.
The railway-train use of 地下鉄 fits the actual broad транспортное средство label.
The actual электропоезд label fits ordinary electric subway trains; not every 電車 is underground.
The actual broad транспортное средство label fits a bicycle; not a claim that a bicycle is an automobile.
The actual Russian alternative транспортное средство is broad enough for a plane. This is a Russian-caption safeguard, NOT an assertion that Japanese 車 ordinarily means aircraft.
A gate is an entrance through the grounds boundary; 入口 explicitly includes gate and its actual caption is вход.
The actual compound label вход; прихожая contains the broad вход, which fits the entrance/gateway sense of 門; not every gate is an entrance hall.
The unchanged accepted 出入口 body explicitly includes gates; actual вход и выход describes an opening used for passage both ways.
The actual mon lexical object has the school/branch-of-learning sense; the current Russian caption школа does not encode which kind.
The actual label сад overlaps partly with парк in ordinary Russian; the captured Russian dictionary explicitly marks partial, not universal, synonymy.
The actual shokudou lexical object has restaurant/eatery sense2; ресторан is defensible for that ordinary sense.
The unchanged 店 article and lexical object explicitly include restaurant; the new actual label ресторан is defensible for that sense.
The unchanged accepted 店 body explicitly includes cafés; the new кофейня; чайная label overlaps that taught establishment sense.
Public eating-establishment sense of 食堂 overlaps the restaurant sense explicitly taught in 店; compare the actual столовая label, not English cafeteria.
The current магазин caption directly fits the department-store sense; this does not create a clique of store subtypes.

semanticDispositions: Keep all27 frozen primary IDs/readings/levels/classifications/tags and all Japanese examples.26N5 plus the actual source-required N4隅; no additional runtime providers/assets/grammar are necessary.
Use each frozen selected lexical identity and its complete teaching, not every dictionary homograph. Retain all inspected alternative candidates for audit/C2, not false adoption.

バス transport is the selected identity; distinct bass-fish/music/bath objects and computing-bus sense do not inherit source N5. A Place sense is not ordinary word evidence. The fish homograph remains a concrete C2 proposal against current魚.
自転車 primaryじてんしゃ remains. API also recordsじでんしゃ; the actual word-page Notes line explicitly labelsじでんしゃ Irregular kana usage. Preserve that qualifier without inventing a raw-API qualifier.
角/かど,角・隅/すみ,角/つの and角/かく are separate observed identities. The rare stage sense is restricted to角, not隅. Attached Wikipedia Horn text is not lexical evidence forかく.

門/もん includes gate, school/branch-of-learning, biology and cannon counter senses. Keep the primary gate teaching, retain sourceN5 and propose the actual школа guard. Different-reading門/かど house/family/door is retained for explicit independent C2 adjudication, not silently merged withもん.

公園 actual lexical definition is (public) park, not public garden. 公苑 is explicitly occasional in park names. The Russian сад/парк evidence says partial synonymy only; preserve public/private distinctions.

レストラン is French-derived, especially Western-style but not exclusively Western cuisine. 食堂/しょくどう includes dining hall/cafeteria and ordinary public eatery;じきどう is the separate Buddhist identity. Do not mechanically translate cafeteria as Russian кафетерий.

図書館 source teaches standardとしょかん. The inspected object additionally recordsずしょかん; phrase the standard-reading explanation as the reading taught here, not a universal impossibility claim about every other form.

戸 object's ordinary door sense is restricted to戸 even though the object also lists門/と. Do NOT transfer its door sense to門/と. Its archaic entrance and narrows, Place and Wikipedia definitions do not create ordinary guards.

Do not treat Wikipedia/Place enrichment, broad common English glosses, containment, part/whole, shared referents or transitive categories as standalone Russian-caption proof. 荷物/鞄/箱, passages/道 and venues/建物 are not automatically exclusion cliques.
